cells_note: [x, y, w, h] in image pixels, origin top left, of the part of each cell a face may sample (the inner 480 px; a 16 px gutter of the same picture round it). Each is cell_m of wood square.
orientation: rick_sides, log_bark and split_face: the grain along image x; rick_ends and round_end: end grain, no axis
note: The yard woodpiles' wood: split billet ends racked in a rick (two cells), the sticks along their length, a sawn round's end, oak/hickory log bark, and a split face along the grain. Woods of the 1812 groves (oak, hickory, ash, elm), most a season stacked and greying. Reconstructed appearance.
generation_method: deterministic procedural synthesis (tools/generate_yard_wood_pbr.py); no photograph sampled
